image_motivation: The idea of the universe waking up and looking at itself is a strong visual metaphor — it captures the core insight vividly.
image_prompt: A vast dark cosmos with swirling galaxies and stars, and at the center, a single luminous human eye opening wide, made of nebula gas and starlight, looking outward and inward at the same time, the pupil reflecting the same cosmos it sits within — recursive, glowing, alone, wondering.
